name: Detail Effluent Plant (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses EffluentPlantRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-095, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route/factory files)

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewEffluentPlantView.vue's detail mode exactly (Effluent Plant ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid Effluent Plant Detail with all 19 reading/status columns), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/effluent-plant/{id} registered after /data/effluent-plant/create (screen-115) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}
UNLIKE Detail Threshing: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section -- no query, no reference data of any kind
404 handled automatically by ModelNotFoundException -> ApiExceptionHandler (findOrFail), same as every other detail screen in this codebase

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DetailEffluentPlantTest.php) was authored but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review.
